title: JANUS Mirror-Debt Audit for Forward/Reverse Viral Pathways
scope: Computational representation audit only. No pathogen engineering, wet-lab protocol, clinical treatment claim, or operational viral manipulation is contained here.
question: When a viral pathway is observed in the forward direction and independently reconstructed in reverse, which missing states, transition properties, contextual variables, or observation limits are exposed by their mismatch?

core.mirror: M(G_R) changes comparison orientation only; it does not assume equality of states, rates, barriers, or contexts.

novelty_boundary.candidate_contribution: A JANUS-style sufficiency audit that converts forward/reverse mismatch into typed representation debt and requires a falsifying witness before expanding the model. The intended output is not merely 'the pathways differ' but 'which part of the current representation is insufficient and what class of evidence would distinguish the competing models'.

R1_benchmark.method: Retrospective cross-system literature benchmark with explicit reversible negative controls.

cases.witness: disassembly contained two unexpected intermediate structure classes not identified in prior self-assembly observations
assembly capsid-like transient species versus disassembly fractal-branched clusters plus hysteretic dynamics
direction-dependent inferred energy barriers and critical nucleus behavior

cases.role: strong negative control because direct HS-AFM observations support the same local alternative pathways in reverse

R1_benchmark.result: The audit does not label every system asymmetric: it separates reverse-specific state debt, transition/kinetic debt, and explicit mirror-compatible controls.
R1_benchmark.claim_limit: R1 demonstrates a coherent nontrivial classifier at literature-description resolution only. It does not demonstrate prospective information gain.

R2_gate.name: BLIND_MIRROR_INFORMATION_GAIN_GATE
protocol: freeze a forward graph from a dataset before exposing the analyzer to a withheld reverse segment/state class
produce a ranked typed-debt hypothesis with provenance
score whether the predicted missing state/edge class is present
repeat with at least one explicitly reversible negative control
preserve FAIL and UNKNOWN without post-hoc retargeting
R2_gate.pass_condition: A pre-frozen debt hypothesis recovers information in withheld reverse data at a rate better than the declared baseline while negative controls remain unflagged.
R2_gate.failure_condition: The method only restates features already supplied in the visible data, flags reversible controls, or requires post-hoc reinterpretation.

outbound_policy.language: Open method proposal with retrospective sanity benchmark; feedback and prior-art corrections welcome.
do_not_claim: proof that time does not exist
demonstrated utility to a specific laboratory before R2
